text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali holds a meeting with Higher Education Minister Daly Jazi on the ministry foreign policy in boosting cooperation with foreign countries in higher education.
- Tunisia reduced price of school stationery by five percent from July 21 to the end of October on the occasion of new school year.
- Tunisia and South Korea to boost bilateral cooperation in sports sector.
- Tunisia produces 40 percent of its medicine needs and aims to reach 60 percent in the coming years.
